body.x: LG introduced Grams of 2018 and various appliances at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

LG’s 2018 gram was installed with a 72mph large-capacity battery, which doubled its hours of battery use. In addition, the computer is equipped with Intel 8th generation CPU that supports quad-core with low power consumption, and with the latest DDR4 memory that has increased its bandwidth to 240MHz so it has advanced in performance.
LG also introduced ‘Puricare 360-degree air cleaner’ that is the strongest and fastest clean effect of sucking dust in all directions and ‘Code zero A9’, a vacuum cleaner with 140W of suction power.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
